  • Constructor Details

    • Drone

      public Drone(int[][] environment, int row, int col, int sensorFoV, int cellSize)
      Creates a visual drone at its starting cell and initializes its replay path.
      Parameters:
      environment - occupancy grid indexed by row and column, with -1 marking obstacles
      row - zero-based grid row
      col - zero-based grid column
      sensorFoV - simulated sensor radius in grid cells
      cellSize - display size of one grid cell in world pixels
